question: Which of the following ancient Indian philosophers deliberated on the smallest particle of matter and named it 'Parmanu'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanada**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Maharishi Kanad was the ancient Indian philosopher who named the smallest particles of matter "parmanu":**
 
• Kanad **believed that all matter is made up of very small particles **called paramanu, which are indivisible.
 
• He also believed that paramanu exists in two states: motion and absolute rest.</strong&
